title: The keyboard reaches the card menu, pin and collapse controls
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Golf Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Bravo Co", "Charlie Co", "Golf Co").
  • Work orders (Approved): lead Ana — Alpha Co, Bravo Co; lead Ben — Charlie Co; no lead — Golf Co.
  • Ana is not pinned for you at the start (step 6 pins and unpins her).
  • Put the mouse aside. From step 4 on, use only the keyboard.
  • The keyboard and focus design is not finished yet (the design shows no keyboard behaviour). Where a step names a key, try Tab, Shift+Tab, the arrow keys, Enter, Space and Escape, and write down which key does what.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Charlie Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls Golf Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  4. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls" in Search — exactly 4 work orders show, all Approved: Alpha Co and Bravo Co led by Ana, Charlie Co led by Ben, Golf Co with no lead. In Board View Ana's column header shows the pin button unpinned; if she is pinned, unpin her first. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls" in Search so only this case's work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Using only the keyboard, focus the Alpha Co card and move focus to its more-actions button.
  5. Press Enter to open the menu, then press Escape.
  6. Move focus to the pin button in Ana's column header and press Enter, then press Enter again.
  7. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  8. Move focus to the collapse button of Ana's group and press Enter, then press Enter again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the more-actions button appears when the card has keyboard focus (not only on mouse hover).
  • Step 5: Enter (or Space) opens the menu and Escape closes it.
  • Step 6: Ana is pinned, then unpinned, using only the keyboard.
  • Step 8: Ana's group collapses, then expands, using only the keyboard.
  • Engineering is building these now. The exact keys are not designed yet: write down the keys that worked.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus); SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S11-R2, S11-R5, S11-R7, S11-R8, S3-R13, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, SQ-15 (Open) and UX-19 (Open). Inline PRD comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 28 Sep 2026, lists what is still open with design. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R2: “Design must define keyboard access to the more-actions menu.”
  • S11-R5: “Design must define how Escape cancels an interaction.”
  • S11-R7: “Design must define keyboard access to pin and unpin.”
  • S11-R8: “Design must define keyboard access to group collapse and expand.”
  • S3-R13: “Reveal the card’s more-actions overlay on hover or keyboard focus.”
  • Tech plan Phase 11 controls: “Every control is a real button with an `aria-label`; the more-actions overlay reveals on `:focus-within`; pin and collapse are keyboard-reachable (S11-R2, S11-R7, S11-R8)”
  • Tech plan Phase 11 tests menu: “more-actions opens with Enter and Space; the overlay is visible on focus”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
